name: Trödelmarkt an der Veltins Arena
facts: every Saturday and Tuesday, selling from 08:00 to 14:00 on weekdays
on car park D3 at the Veltins-Arena
second-hand goods of all kinds and collectables, packed and unpacked goods, textiles and food
multicultural stalls: Turkish baked goods, fruit and vegetables, oriental clothing
new goods may only be sold by traders with a valid Reisegewerbekarte; counterfeits are strictly prohibited
runs on 2026-10-03 despite the public holiday
cancelled on 2026-10-31 for a Schalke home game, with no replacement on 2026-11-01 because it is a quiet holiday in NRW
on 2026-11-21 selling ends at 11:00 because of an evening Schalke home game
notes: Dates are derived from the stated 'every Saturday and Tuesday' rhythm, with the organiser's own exception list applied: 2026-10-17 cancelled (Schalke home game) and moved to Sunday 2026-10-18; 2026-10-31 cancelled and no market on 2026-11-01. The organiser says further Schalke fixtures are not yet scheduled and that a Saturday 15:30 home game means they try to move the market to the Sunday — so dates from December onwards may still shift. 2026-11-21 runs but closes at 11:00, not 14:00. The 08:00 start comes from the Marktordnung ('Werktage: Verkauf von 08:00 bis 14:00 Uhr'); the market page itself only gives the 14:00 close. No visitor entry fee is stated, so fee is null. The organiser writes the postcode as 45891; some directories say 45881.

description.de: Zweimal die Woche, dienstags und samstags von 8 bis 14 Uhr, auf dem Parkplatz D3 an der Veltins-Arena. Gebrauchtes aller Art und Sammlerstücke, dazu türkisches Gebäck, Obst und Gemüse und orientalische Kleidung. An Schalker Heimspieltagen fällt der Markt aus oder endet früher.
description.en: Twice a week, Tuesdays and Saturdays from 8 to 2, on car park D3 at the Veltins-Arena. Second-hand goods of every kind and collectables, with Turkish baked goods, fruit and vegetables and oriental clothing alongside. On Schalke home-match days the market is cancelled or closes early.
